newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei plunges at close but over key support.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei plunges at close but over key support.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei stock index futures plunged at the close on Tuesday following a surge in the Japanese government bond (JGB) futures, dealers said.
They said morning rumours that Japan's Ministry of Finance would buy about 100 billion worth of outright bonds caused the Nikkei to drop sharply.
"We saw JGBs rising on that rumour and hitting Nikkei as a result," a dealer with a European institution said.
The rumour was subsequently proven unfounded as there were no evidence of such purchases, dealers said.
After hitting a high of 20,585 in the morning, September Nikkei contract ended at 20,140, down 415 points from its previous close. Volume was fairly active around 23,445 lots.
A heavy sell-off in Japanese banking and medical stocks dragged SIMEX stock index futures down as well, dealers said.
Good support was seen at 20,100, underpinned by continued strength of the dollar against the yen, dealers said.
The dollar continued to firm against the Japanese currency and was last trading above 115 yen.
